evals.prompt: How do I write a build log for a feature I built with an AI coding agent?
evals.expected_output: Follows the six steps: define the target, map the stack, write the prompt first, orchestrate agents, iterate with evals, and document the log with metrics.
assertions: Writes the prompt before the code
Shows what the human edited and why

evals.prompt: Can I claim a build was AI-native if I only used autocomplete?
evals.expected_output: No. The skill warns against claiming AI-native when AI was not used, and against hiding the human judgment layer.
assertions: Warns against claiming AI-native without real AI use
Requires showing the human judgment layer
Requires metrics, because claims without them are not proof

evals.expected_output: Recommends publishing sanitized prompts with the result and metrics, so the log is reproducible and auditable.
assertions: Includes metrics such as time saved and iterations
Keeps the log reproducible and auditable
